## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the red can and the cylindrical can with smooth surface simultaneously, then place both in the hard plastic rectangular box.

Task description: Pick up both the red can to the left of the blue rectangular box and the smooth cylindrical can with a red-and-white design on its right, then place both inside the hard plastic box.

Success criteria: Both cans are in the blue rectangular box, each horizontally near either of the two target placement positions inside; both grippers are open and have released the cans.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a flat side wall around the upper-middle of the can body, away from both rolled rims, so the pads contact fully on both sides. Leave room for the fingertips to clear the box rim when placing it inside.
- Open slightly wider than the can diameter and confirm fingers on opposite sides before closing. Smooth cans can slide; check for downward slipping during a gentle lift and adjust the grasp position accordingly.
- For simultaneous grasping, consider having each gripper approach the can on its side. Near the box opening, leave clearance between both cans and both grippers to avoid squeezing them together.
- Before entering the box opening, clear its rim with the can bottom and fingertips. During descent, watch the gap to the inner wall to avoid scraping the rim and pushing the plastic box. Obtain bottom support before release to reduce drops and tipping.
